meta.name: ai-models
meta.description: Research, compare, and update AI model configurations. Covers text model tiers, image and video generation models, image tool models, pricing data sourcing, and the budget/rate-limit system. Use when bumping model versions, adding new models, updating pricing, or auditing model specs against provider documentation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调研、对比并更新AI模型配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要管理AI模型配置、版本和定价信息
copy.tagline_en: Research, compare, and update AI model configurations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage AI model configs, versions, and pricing

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你查询、比较和更新 AI 模型的配置信息，包括文本、图像、视频等模型的版本、定价和规格。
howto.when: 当你需要升级模型版本、添加新模型、更新定价数据，或核对模型规格与官方文档是否一致时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下 Claude Sonnet 4.6 的最新定价。
say.note: Claude 会运行脚本查询模型信息。

say.text: 添加一个新的图像生成模型，供应商是 fal.ai。
say.note: Claude 会指导你完成添加流程。

say.text: 更新 Veo 3.1 在 fal.ai 上的定价。
say.note: Claude 会检查并更新定价数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you research, compare, and update AI model configurations, including version, pricing, and specs for text, image, and video models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to bump model versions, add new models, update pricing data, or audit model specs against provider documentation.

say_en.text: Look up the latest pricing for Claude Sonnet 4.6.
say_en.note: Claude runs the model info script.

say_en.text: Add a new image generation model from fal.ai.
say_en.note: Claude guides you through the addition.
Claude checks and updates pricing data.
